infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Prince Baby Tracker uses the microphone so you can log feeds, sleep, and diapers hands-free by speaking.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Prince Baby Tracker turns your speech into a logged event, like "feed done 120 ml at 12".
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Add a photo of your baby to their profile and memories.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo of your baby for their profile and memories.
